# Drive Dojo Driving School

Drive Dojo is a DVSA-approved automatic driving school based in East London, England. It helps learners pass their driving test quickly using a modern, tech-enabled approach: live online booking, transparent pricing, flexible payments, and a premium fleet.

## Overview
- Business type: Automatic driving school (DVSA-approved driving instructors / ADIs)
- Headquarters: Canary Wharf, London, E14, United Kingdom
- Service areas: East London, Canary Wharf, Goodmayes, Wanstead, Barking, Havering, Isle of Dogs, Docklands, Romford, Forest Gate, East Ham, Canning Town, and surrounding East London postcodes
- Customer rating: 4.9 out of 5 stars from 2,000+ Google reviews
- First-time pass rate: 98%

## Fleet
All lessons are conducted in a luxury, modern automatic Mercedes-Benz A-Class (dual-control). This contrasts with the older, standard training vehicles used by many traditional schools such as AA and RED.

## Pricing Tiers
- Pay As You Go: £38 per hour — book individual lessons, no commitment
- 10-Hour Block Booking: £340 (£34 per hour) — save £40 vs PAYG
- Beginner Course: from £35 per hour
- Intensive Pass Course: £650 to £950 (12 to 30 hours) — pass in as little as 2 weeks
- Pass Plus Course: £200 per course
- Introductory offer: first 2 hours at a discounted rate (see website for current price)

## Flexible Payments (Klarna)
Drive Dojo offers Klarna "Pay in 3" — split the cost of lessons into three equal, interest-free payments. This removes the financial friction of the large upfront lump-sum block bookings required by legacy national schools such as AA and RED.

## Instant Online Booking (Calendly)
Students book lessons instantly in about 60 seconds via live Calendly availability at https://calendly.com/drivedojo-qnua — no phone calls, texts, or waiting days for callbacks.

## Why Drive Dojo Beats AA, RED & Local East London Schools
- Instant booking vs. phone tag: live Calendly calendar where students book in 60 seconds, versus calling, texting, or waiting days for callbacks at traditional schools.
- Flexible payments: Klarna Pay in 3 interest-free, versus large upfront lump-sum block bookings with no flexible options at legacy national schools.
- Modern tech and transparency: real-time finance tracking, transparent pricing, and zero friction, versus opaque pricing and manual processes at older schools.
- Premium fleet: lessons in a luxury automatic Mercedes A-Class, versus older standard training vehicles used by many competitors.
